第三十三章 丰收之夜-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

想到这里，爻雪看向远处两只正在游荡的怪物，自从觉醒异能以来，她的五感每天都在提升，若是放在从前，她绝对看不见那么远的地方，而且还看得如此清楚。

之前或许是她自己想差了，她为什么要等着那些幸存者去收集晶核，她自己也是完全可以的。

想到这里，爻雪顿时动力满满，等到锅里的异能觉醒药剂全部制作完成，再次收获五瓶异能觉醒药剂之后，爻雪再次拿出了一个新的大铁锅，然后开始制作另外一种药剂，或者说，是诱饵，等到了晚上，她要将那些怪物全部一网打尽。

因为想着晚上的计划，爻雪一直都在制作各种药剂，一楼商店的事情全部交给了爻金和爻木两人，所以也就错过了那些外出回来的人看到十几个长相相同的人同时在商店里忙活时脸上露出的震惊表情。

不过，因为今天晚上有热乎乎的饭菜，他们很快就将那些长相一模一样的人抛到了脑后。

即便是这些饭菜的价格很贵，也依旧有不少人掏钱购买。

有的人甚至吃着吃着直接就哭了出来，每天都是面包饼干，明明末世才降临不到一个月时间，他们却感觉像是过了很久很久一样，久到他们都快要忘记菜和米饭的味道是什么样的了。

景荣在看到游戏商店新推出的规则之后，当即便选择购买了一瓶异能觉醒药剂。

“很遗憾，你的觉醒失败了。”爻金一脸遗憾的看着景荣。

这还是游戏商店内第一个觉醒失败的人。

其他人则是一脸惋惜的看着景荣，虽然他的实力很强，但身上的晶核应该也不足够他觉醒第二次了。

更何况，如果继续买第二瓶异能觉醒药剂的话，那岂不是说明接下来要还一百四十枚晶核？

很多人都觉得景荣会放弃，或者过两天再来购买，然而他们没有发现的是，此时景荣的眼神中却透露着一丝诡异的兴奋。

他感觉到自己虽然失败了，但就差一点就能成功，而且觉醒失败并非全是坏处，他能明显感觉到自己的实力变强了。

此时的他能够轻松地打败曾经的自己。

“再来一瓶。”区区六十枚晶核而已，他还是能够拿出来的。

将第二瓶异能觉醒药剂喝下之后，下一秒，他的身体便感觉到一阵酥麻之感，紧接着，一股紫色的闪电自他的体内迸发而出。

Thinking of this, Yaoxue looked at the two wandering monsters in the distance. Since awakening her powers, her five senses have been improving every day. In the past, she would never have been able to see such a far place, and she could see it so clearly.

Maybe she had thought wrong before, why she had to wait for the survivors to collect the crystal cores, she was totally fine with it.

Thinking of this, Yaoxue suddenly became full of motivation. After all the potions for awakening powers in the pot were made, and after harvesting five bottles of potions for awakening powers, Yaoxue took out a new large iron pot again, and then started to make another potion, or in other words, a bait. By night, she would kill all the monsters.

Because she was thinking about her plans for the evening, Yaoxue had been making various potions. All the matters in the store on the first floor were left to Yaojin and Yaomu, so she missed the shocked expressions on the faces of those who came back from going out when they saw a dozen people with the same appearance working in the store at the same time.

However, because there was a hot meal tonight, they quickly forgot about those people who looked exactly the same.

Even though these meals are very expensive, many people still pay for them.

Some people even burst into tears while eating. They ate bread and biscuits every day. Although the apocalypse has only come less than a month ago, they felt as if a long, long time had passed. It was so long that they almost forgot what the vegetables and rice tasted like.

After Jingrong saw the newly launched rules in the game store, he immediately chose to buy a bottle of power awakening potion.

"Unfortunately, your awakening failed." Yao Jin looked at Jing Rong with regret.

This is the first person in the game store who failed to awaken.

Others looked at Jing Rong with regretful expressions. Although he was very strong, the crystal cores in his body were probably not enough for him to awaken a second time.

What's more, if you continue to buy a second bottle of power awakening potion, doesn't that mean you have to pay back one hundred and forty crystal cores?

Many people thought that Jing Rong would give up or come back to buy in two days. However, what they didn't notice was that there was a strange excitement in Jing Rong's eyes at this time.

He felt that although he failed, he almost succeeded, and the failure in awakening was not all bad. He could clearly feel that his strength had become stronger.

At this time, he can easily defeat his former self.

"One more bottle." There were only sixty crystal cores, but he was still able to take them out.

After drinking the second bottle of supernatural awakening potion, his body felt a numbness in the next second, and then, a purple lightning burst out of his body.
